tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your office communication with the SNOM D717 Desk Telephone, a high-performance IP phone designed for professional offices, call centers, and enterprises in Bangladesh. With 6 SIP accounts, dual Gigabit Ethernet ports, and HD wideband audio, the SNOM D717 delivers crystal-clear voice quality and seamless multitasking. Its high-resolution graphical display and intuitive interface make navigation easy, while the ergonomic design ensures comfort during long hours of use.


Ideal for busy corporate environments, call centers, and office setups, the SNOM D717 Desk Telephone combines advanced VoIP features, reliable performance, and scalable connectivity, allowing your team to manage high call volumes efficiently.


Key Technical Specifications

  • Model: SNOM D717
  • SIP Accounts: Up to 6 SIP identities/accounts
  • Display: High-resolution backlit graphical display (color or monochrome, depending on version)
  • Audio: HD wideband audio, full-duplex speakerphone, acoustic echo cancellation
  • Connectivity: Dual Gigabit Ethernet ports (10/100/1000 Mbps), PoE support
  • Keys: 10 programmable function keys, 4 context-sensitive soft keys, 5 configurable navigation keys
  • Protocols & Security: SIP 2.0, SRTP, TLS, VLAN support, QoS (DiffServ)
  • Design: Ergonomic black desk phone with adjustable stand and intuitive interface
  • Power: PoE powered (Power adapter optional, not included)
  • Advanced Features: Call transfer, hold, forwarding, conferencing, BLF (Busy Lamp Field), voicemail access, auto-provisioning\
  • Ideal For: Call centers, corporate offices, enterprise VoIP systems, and professional communication setups in Bangladesh
